invariants_enforced: Zero gaming of metrics: BER, CRC, Viterbi, LDPC, and RS decoding are strictly executed against genuine baseband samples
Candidate FEC never downgrades to none (candidate requested FEC == decoder.fec_used)
Candidate interleaver never downgrades to none (candidate requested interleaver == decoder.interleaver_used)
Authoritative winner strictly derived from HypothesisEngineV1.rank_candidates()
Candidate cache isolation prevents cross-candidate contamination
Zero truth-file or cheat reads at runtime (adversarially verified with filesystem interceptor)
Adversarial invariance against file renaming, path alteration, and folder location
Honest abstention to UNKNOWN on unverified, low SNR, and headerless/swapped captures (G7, G9, G10)
Multi-emission scanning detects wideband spectrum multiplexing (G8 produces 4 emission candidates)
Confidence semantics: UNKNOWN decisions carry deflated confidence (<=0.40)
Strict reproducibility and deterministic seed propagation across all pipelines
